blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla appeared before the Department of Justice (DOJ) on Friday as the preliminary investigation into the obstruction of justice allegations against him got underway. The Philippine National Police’s (PNP) Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) filed the complaint over Padilla’s alleged assistance to fellow lawmaker Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa […]...
